items.tier: primary text (scriptural narrative; not independently verified as a historical event)
items.quote: And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:
items.claim: The text (Exodus 11:4) has Moses say, speaking for the LORD, that the LORD will go out into the midst of Egypt about midnight.
items.action: announces divine going out into Egypt
items.mechanism: divine intervention announced through a prophet

items.tier: primary text (scriptural narrative; not independently verified as a historical event)
items.quote: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die, from the first born of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne, even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill; and all the firstborn of beasts.
items.claim: The text (Exodus 11:5) says that all firstborn in Egypt will die, from Pharaoh's firstborn to the firstborn of the lowest servant, along with the firstborn of livestock.
items.object: firstborn of Egypt, human and animal, across all social ranks
